draft.shortGloss: to speak; to say; to explain

notes: 说 (shuō) is the most common verb for speaking, talking, or saying something.
Do not confuse with 告诉 (gàosù, to tell someone) or 说话 (shuōhuà, to speak/talk as an intransitive verb).
